question: Among all products sold in the United States with promo_id=999, considering only those cities whose sales increased by at least 20% from Q4 2019 (calendar_quarter_id=1772) to Q4 2020 (calendar_quarter_id=1776), which product that ranks in the top 20% of total sales has the smallest percentage-point change in its share of total sales between these two quarters?
sql:
WITH us_sales AS (
    SELECT s.prod_id, c.cust_city, s.amount_sold, t.calendar_quarter_id
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE s.promo_id = 999
      AND co.country_name = 'United States of America'
      AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
),
city_sales AS (
    SELECT cust_city, calendar_quarter_id, SUM(amount_sold) as total_sales
    FROM us_sales
    GROUP BY cust_city, calendar_quarter_id
),
city_comparison AS (
    SELECT q19.cust_city, q19.total_sales as sales_q19, q20.total_sales as sales_q20
    FROM city_sales q19
    LEFT JOIN city_sales q20 ON q19.cust_city = q20.cust_city AND q20.calendar_quarter_id = 1776
    WHERE q19.calendar_quarter_id = 1772
),
qualifying_cities AS (
    SELECT cust_city
    FROM city_comparison
    WHERE sales_q19 > 0
      AND (sales_q20 - sales_q19) / sales_q19 >= 0.20
),
product_city_sales AS (
    SELECT us.prod_id, us.cust_city, us.calendar_quarter_id, us.amount_sold
    FROM us_sales us
    WHERE us.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
),
product_total_sales AS (
    SELECT prod_id, SUM(amount_sold) as total_sales
    FROM product_city_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id
),
product_rank AS (
    SELECT prod_id, total_sales,
           NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) as percentile_rank
    FROM product_total_sales
),
top_20_pct AS (
    SELECT prod_id, total_sales
    FROM product_rank
    WHERE percentile_rank = 1
),
quarterly_shares AS (
    SELECT pcs.prod_id, pcs.calendar_quarter_id,
           SUM(pcs.amount_sold) as quarter_sales,
           (SELECT SUM(amount_sold) FROM product_city_sales pcs2 
            WHERE pcs2.calendar_quarter_id = pcs.calendar_quarter_id) as total_quarter_sales
    FROM product_city_sales pcs
    WHERE pcs.prod_id IN (SELECT prod_id FROM top_20_pct)
    GROUP BY pcs.prod_id, pcs.calendar_quarter_id
),
shares_with_pct AS (
    SELECT prod_id, calendar_quarter_id, quarter_sales, total_quarter_sales,
           100.0 * quarter_sales / total_quarter_sales as share_pct
    FROM quarterly_shares
),
product_changes AS (
    SELECT s1.prod_id,
           s1.share_pct as share_q19,
           s2.share_pct as share_q20,
           ABS(s2.share_pct - s1.share_pct) as pct_point_change
    FROM shares_with_pct s1
    JOIN shares_with_pct s2 ON s1.prod_id = s2.prod_id
      AND s1.calendar_quarter_id = 1772
      AND s2.calendar_quarter_id = 1776
)
SELECT pc.prod_id, p.prod_name, pc.share_q19, pc.share_q20, pc.pct_point_change
FROM product_changes pc
JOIN products p ON pc.prod_id = p.prod_id
ORDER BY pc.pct_point_change ASC
